Mayawati urges UP govt to appeal medical college quota stay in Supreme Court

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has urged the Uttar Pradesh government to immediately approach the Supreme Court after the Allahabad High Court stayed a decision regarding reservations in medical colleges. The High Court's order affected the quota for medical college admissions. Mayawati stated that the state government should pursue the matter at the highest judicial level to ensure justice for the affected students.
